title: Weight and fall of a body with its own mark in the field of a held source

key_results.statement: Held body ($\tau=0$), couplings (a) and (c), $N_f\ge1$, $L\ge5$, every level and branch, lowest adapted field state, $|g_b|+|g_s|<t_f\omega_{\min}/2$: exactly $W_{k,\sigma}(x)-W_{k,\sigma}(x')=N_f[\varepsilon_0(x)-\varepsilon_0(x')]$, with $\varepsilon_0(x)$ the lowest eigenvalue of $h_x=C_1+g_bP_x+g_sP_{x_s}$, $g_b=\sigma\gamma M_k$.

Same class, first order in $g_s$, through second order in $\gamma$: $W_{k,\sigma}(x)=\mathrm{const}-\frac{2ng_sg_b}{t_f}\Lambda^+(x,x_s)+\frac{ng_sg_b^2}{t_f^2}[2G_0\Lambda^+(x,x_s)+\Lambda^+(x,x_s)^2-\frac2L(\Lambda^{+2})(x,x_s)]+O(g_s^2)+O(g_sg_b^3)$ at fixed $L,N_f,t_f$.
Same class and order, on the ring with $u=r(L-r)$: $W_{k,\sigma}(x)-W_{k,\sigma}(x')=\frac{ng_sg_b}{Lt_f}[(1-\frac{(L^2-2)g_b}{6Lt_f})(u-u')+\frac{g_b}{3Lt_f}(u^2-u'^2)]$, $g_b=\sigma\gamma M_k$.

Same class and order: the weight is $\sigma M_k\gamma\,\delta N(x)+M_k^2\gamma^2\Theta(x)$; at first order in $\gamma$ it is the one function $\gamma\delta N(x)$ of (5.8) times the factor $\sigma M_k$ (rest-and-clock cost) for all levels and both branches; through second order, for $\gamma g_s\ne0$, it does not factorize: its place dependence changes at relative order $\gamma$ between the two branches of every level and between levels with different $M_k$; no member of the class is a control.

Under regime R (band dynamics in the isolated dressed level, heavy body $\tau^2\ll M_kt_f$, weight at $\tau=0$, lowest order $\tau^2$), first order in $g_s$: the drift acceleration from rest at $P=0$ is $a_{k,\sigma}(0)=-E''_{k,\sigma}(0)W'_{k,\sigma}(x_0)$ with central lattice slope.

Under R, both couplings, $x_0\ne x_s$, inside (6.4), first order in $g_s$, through relative order $\gamma$: $a_{k,\sigma}(0)=-\frac{\tau^2\gamma ng_s(L-2r_0)}{Lt_f}[1+\epsilon\gamma n-\sigma\frac{\gamma M_k}{t_f}\frac{(L-2r_0)^2+2}{6L}]+O(\tau^2g_s\gamma^3)+O(g_s^2)$, $\epsilon=-1$ (a), $+1$ (c).

Same conditions: the fall is level- and branch-independent at leading order, $-\tau^2\gamma\delta N'(x_0)$, but not at relative order $\gamma$: the term $\Delta_{k,\sigma}=-\sigma\frac{\gamma M_k}{t_f}\frac{(L-2r_0)^2+2}{6L}$, first order in $\gamma M_k/t_f$, odd in $\sigma$, proportional to $M_k$, present for $\gamma g_s\ne0$ at every $x_0\ne x_s$ off the antipode, for every member of the class.

definitions.name: One-object contract with body and source point terms
Coupling of the body on level k and branch sigma to the field
Regime R of the fall (band dynamics, heavy body)
Level- and branch-dependent relative correction of the fall

open_issues: Regime R is an assumption; corrections of relative order τ²/(M_k t_f) and τ²/M_k² to the weight of a moving dressed body are not computed.
The isolation (6.4) is quoted only for σ=+ at P=0; for σ=− (7.8) needs the isolation condition of 06-own-mark in its full form, not quoted here.

The geometric factor in (7.8), (7.9) belongs to the central lattice slope read from (5.7); another slope changes it and its zeros, while the order γ and parameter γM_k/t_f stay the same wherever it is nonzero.
Field states other than the lowest adapted one, and the second order in g_s, are not treated (scope).

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of (7.8): τ, t_f, g_s, M_k in contract units, γ and n pure numbers; acceleration in position labels per λ² as in (5.7)
Test-body limit: dropping the own-mark term of (7.8) reproduces (5.7) with (5.8) through relative order γ for both couplings
Limits: (7.8) vanishes for τ→0 (flat dressed level, (6.7)), for g_s=0 (translation invariance) and at the antipode (reflection symmetry)
